description: This file defines classes and methods related to product pricelists, including price types, pricelist types, pricelists, pricelist versions, and pricelist items, for an OpenERP/Odoo module.

classes.name: price_type
classes.description: Defines different types of product prices, including associated product fields and currencies.

classes.name: product_pricelist_type
classes.description: Defines types of pricelists, used for categorizing different pricelist sets.

classes.name: product_pricelist
classes.description: Main class representing a product pricelist, including methods for retrieving prices and managing versions.

classes.name: product_pricelist_version
classes.description: Represents a version of a pricelist with validity dates and associated items.

classes.name: product_pricelist_item
classes.description: Defines individual pricing rules within a pricelist version, including base price calculations and constraints.

methods.name: _price_field_get
methods.description: Retrieves product fields of type float that can be used as price points.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Determines the default currency for the current user or company.

methods.name: _pricelist_type_get
methods.description: Fetches available pricelist types for selection.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns the display name for a pricelist, including its currency.

methods.name: price_get
methods.description: Calculates the price of a product based on the pricelist, quantity, partner, and context.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that pricelist versions do not have overlapping date ranges.

methods.name: _check_recursion
methods.description: Ensures a pricelist item does not reference itself as its base price.

methods.name: product_id_change
methods.description: Updates the rule name based on the selected product's code.
